max_players_basis: documented: the largest table a shipped game declares (mafia, 4-12)

numeric_bids.note: number answers with min/max from state

private_channel.note: mafia confer: a step addressed to a subset

variable_player_count.note: a roster that scales with the table

shared_deck_draw.note: options can come from a game list; drawing is remove/append operations

payoff_matrix.note: no lookup operation: rps needs about 13 steps for a 9-cell matrix

player_attribute_compare.note: no player-attribute operand: keep a table attribute beside the score

arithmetic_ranking.note: rank endings were replaced by a model-decided winner; an arithmetic one needs calc

conditional_subsequence.note: the step list is flat: a whole BLOCK of steps cannot be chosen instead of another block. This is NOT a limit on conditional scoring or conditional updates: a single step can carry a `when` condition and a single operation an `if`, both arithmetic, so 'the poisoner scores if the choices match, otherwise the chooser' is fine

spatial_board.note: out of scope by decision: the game depends on a spatial board (a grid, map, movement or adjacency)

trading_between_players.note: no mechanism for a player to propose and a player to accept an exchange

binding_agreements.note: talk is not enforced; a promise cannot bind
